question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Perfume
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **'Stench'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The English meaning of **'Perfume'** is 'a fragrant liquid typically made from essential oils extracted from flowers and spices, used to impart a pleasant smell to one's body or clothes'. (इत्र) 

 
 
• **Example-** 'She put on her favorite perfume before she left the house'.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym of **'Perfume' **in the options given is** 'Stench'.** 
 
• The English meaning of** 'Stench'** is 'a strong and very unpleasant smell'.(दुर्गंध) 
 
 
• **Example:- **'The stench of rotting food was unbearable'.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- 'Option 4' i.e.** 'Stench'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1** 'Extraordinary'** English meaning is 'very unusual or remarkable'(असाधारण)
 
• Option 2 **'Redolence'** English meaning is 'smelling sweet and pleasant',(सुगंधित)
 
• Option 3 '**Fragrance'** English meaning is 'a sweet or pleasant smell',(महक)
